mechanism.claim: The next six-hour BTC direction after an irregular six-block confirmation ladder depends jointly on the normalized within-ladder price path, finalized block-weight allocation, transaction-density allocation, and confirmation-tempo allocation. One fixed ridge trained only on May-June 2023 can estimate this multistate transmission before 2023H2 begins.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the frozen ridge prediction
mechanism.why_distinct: Prior ladder candidates each froze one hand-written rule over returns, aggregate weight, transaction density, or duration. CLMSRR uses all 24 ordered per-interval coordinates in one standardized linear shrinkage model, no prior candidate event set or control, no OOS adaptation, and no hand-selected interaction. Repository collision search found no confirmation-ladder fitted model.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: OOS ladders must exceed the frozen 65th percentile of pre-2023H2 ladder return variation and the 75th percentile of absolute fitted prediction strength.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: height-modulo asynchronous confirmations and sparse frozen score tails are absent from Gross9 primitives

training_contract.label: log(exit_open/entry_open), entry=feature_available_time+5m, exit=entry+6h; both contained in fit window
training_contract.training_rows: all source-valid exact merged ladder rows with finite ordered features and complete label; no outcome filtering or reservation
training_contract.standardization: population mean/std on fit rows only; reject nonfinite or zero scale
training_contract.estimator: closed-form ridge with unpenalized intercept, alpha=100.0
training_contract.prediction_strength_threshold: numpy linear-method q75 of absolute fitted predictions
training_contract.variation_threshold: numpy linear-method q65 of ladder variation sqrt(sum six interval returns squared)

feature_contract.returns: six exact confirmation-interval returns divided by their positive L2 norm
feature_contract.weights: log of six positive finalized block weights minus their within-ladder mean log weight
feature_contract.transaction_density: log(tx_count/weight) for each positive block, centered by within-ladder mean
feature_contract.durations: log of six header-time durations in [60,1800] seconds, centered by within-ladder mean
feature_contract.availability: prefix maximum header timestamp and mediantime through H+6 plus 7200 seconds, ceiled to 5m
feature_contract.source_validity: canonical height H divisible by 36, exact H..H+6 chain, six exact complete minute intervals, finite features; no imputation

oos_clock.eligibility: source valid, ladder variation>=frozen q65, abs frozen prediction>=frozen q75, prediction strict nonzero
oos_clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
oos_clock.funding: not input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.oos_execution_prices: sealed until source and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent fixed multistate fitted model specified before labels and OOS incidence

stopping_rule: freeze prereg, trainer, model, source, novelty, economics; terminal first failure; no feature, alpha, fit window, threshold, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, source, model, or control repair
